bandwidth_envelope.semantics: probed on the evaluation device and host in the same run before the candidate loads: contiguous D2D copy, pinned cudaMemcpy H2D/D2H, an SM-driven zero-copy stream over the same pinned buffer compiled with the frozen nvcc command, and concurrent H2D plus D2H copies on two streams; the host envelope is the best of the four one-way host probes and the duplex envelope the best of the concurrent probe and those; device, duplex and other host-memory cases are checked against device, duplex and host envelopes; any case whose implied bandwidth exceeds envelope x margin invalidates the run

draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads the committed instance at judge/private/final_cases.json (or the fetched Infrathon asset) unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another; every host evaluates the same holdout
draw_policy.identity_rule: no (layout, nl, nh, hs) shape, seed or case id is shared between the public table and the holdout; every family covers both layouts' use and both directions in every arm
draw_policy.inputs: Mooncake FAST'25 conversation and toolagent traces (Judge), synthetic trace (public); github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake FAST25-release/traces
draw_policy.privacy: the instance lives on the Judge-only path judge/private/ or in the Infrathon asset root, is staged mode 0600 into a root-only Judge build context, is never present in the Work image and is proven absent from every Work build context by scripts/validate_layout.py; shapes, seeds and block tables are not listed here
draw_policy.redraw: scripts/generate_final_manifest.py --redraw [--seed <int>] regenerates deterministically from the traces (default seed: int.from_bytes(sha256("<suite_id>|<task_id>").digest()[:8], "big")); no system random source is used. A redraw is a NEW suite identity: frozen_instance must be re-recorded and no earlier score is comparable to it.
draw_policy.workload_rule: per-GPU shapes of real models under tensor parallelism (TP 1/2/4/8 where the weights fit); pool sized by the vLLM rule (0.92 of device memory minus weights and a 2.5 GB reserve, capped at 40 GB); block-id tables replayed from the traces through a simplified block manager and cache store; every (shape, layout) is a stratum with per-family quotas; families by call size (16 MiB) plus duplex, trace windows and host overlap; Judge tiers are the paper's evaluation models and other models

frozen_instance.provenance: suite v2 generated 2026-11-08 by scripts/generate_final_manifest.py --redraw (default seed) from the Mooncake FAST'25 traces

selection_semantics: Every admitted auto-* or agent-* round executes the complete frozen final suite with the same timing, gates and score; the agent sees the score, the four group scores, the seven family scores and the gate states, never which cases a family holds or per-case results

suite_gate_timeouts.semantics: per-suite ceilings inside the Judge container

timeout_semantics: suite gates and orchestration ceilings qualify the selected execution profile; they do not identify a GPU model
